V3 PORTABLE ABI & ActorX Root Fix - LOCAL VERIFICATION (2026-10-08)

Source-only release. Build tests run in Linux x86-64, NOT native MSYS2/MinGW32.

GCC: -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic-errors -O2
  - all library/utilities/tests compiled successfully
  - test_exact_integer_abi: ok (int 32-bit on LP64)
  - test_actorx_root_vs_child: ok
  - test_minimal: ok
  - test_numeric_limits: ok

Clang: same strict C89 options with -fsanitize=undefined and
         -fsanitize=address,undefined
  - same test suite: PASS, no sanitizer reports after test helper fix

GNU Make EXEEXT=.exe simulation using host GCC: tests PASS.
  NOTE: these are native Linux binaries with .exe names, not Windows PE files.
  Actual MSYS2 MinGW32 build still requires external verification.

Other checks:
  - two bundled example source files compile in strict C89
  - make clean removes .exe/extensionless executable outputs
  - core has no malloc/free/realloc or declared float/double/64-bit types
  - 8/16/32-bit public primitive ABI is enforced at compile time

Real PSK/PSA motion/UV/materials validation not performed: source archives contain no test assets.
